mailbox.title: The Big Update
mailbox.body:
What the.. that's alot of plants! And zombies too!
Well I cant count them but.. there's alot!
I guess you'll have to wait and see!

mailbox.title: Something chilly
mailbox.body: Brrr! Something's growing beneath the frost! I hope its roots packed a scarf.

mailbox.title: Growing collection
mailbox.body: I counted the leaves. Then I counted them again. Then I lost count! Something big is growing in the garden.

mailbox.title: Cold roots
mailbox.body: Ever had cold feet? Imagine having cold roots! Those zombies might want to bring a spare pair of socks.

mailbox.title: A shocking discovery
mailbox.body: I heard thunder coming from the garden. Funny thing is, there wasn't a cloud in sight! Something's practising its punches.

mailbox.title: More cowbell
mailbox.body: Ding! Dong! The garden's getting rather noisy. I wonder if zombies have sensitive ears?

mailbox.title: Hi Buddy!
mailbox.body: Take this! Have fun for an hour!

mailbox.title: I have an challenge for you
mailbox.body: Win one level without sunflower for 100 wild seeds and unlock blaze leaf

messages.title: Hello Candy!
messages.body: Hiii! The mailbox works! By the way, what are Blaze Leaf's abilities? I'd love to try it before my early access expires!

Okay!! Here's the info!: 
HP: 300
Element: Firey
It Slashes at zombies when they are in its radius!
Damage: 75 + 50 Burn Damage(DOT)
DOT damage: 25
Can attack behind itself too.
Range: 4.5 Tiles.
Every 4 hits on an zombie it will do an double slash that does 90 Damage.
Thank you!! Blaze Leaf sounds awesome! How often does it slash, how often does the burn tick, and is the double slash 90 damage per slash or 90 total?

messages.title: Thank you!!
messages.body: LAVALEEK?! :D Thank you for the seeds and early access! What are Lavaleek's combat stats?

messages.title: FOUR MORE?!
messages.body: Hehe!! Thank you! I claimed Frostroot and am saving the short early access gifts until I can play. What are Frostroot, Cowbell, Boombox Wood and Echo Pea's abilities?
Challenge accepted! I'll attempt Level 12 without Sunflower or its fusions. No rewards claimed until I win!

messages.title: Challenge completed!
messages.body: Level 12 cleared with three stars and zero Sunflowers or Sunflower fusions! May I claim the 100 Wild Seeds and permanent Blaze Leaf unlock?
